facts: Portable MSSR owns host-neutral transition semantics; hosts own observation and delivery.
Attention threshold is review among ok < watch < review < error.
Stable OK/WATCH and unchanged actionable evidence remain quiet.
Entering, changing, escalating, de-escalating or leaving the actionable threshold yields an advisory transition candidate.
The notice can suggest an action but does not authorize or execute it.
Update uses stable-section upsert keyed by physical knowledge kind and exact Markdown heading; replaces only that section and verifies bytes/hash.
expectedSha256 fails closed if target changed concurrently.
Registering a root section and updating Markdown plus manifest is one bounded transaction: validate module, derive source/section, preserve module ID, verify both, restore previous pair on failure.
directive is selectable but not globally active.
No helper persists raw conversation text automatically.
ACCEPT materializes with sufficient observable evidence.
WAIT preserves a plausible candidate without paying context cost yet.
REJECT means not relevant to current task/phase.
Reconsider WAIT only after meaningful observable change such as error, artifact, publish intent, tool/provider failure, user correction or phase transition; not after every successful call.
Reuse/map accepted, pending and explicit skipped host-gated semantics instead of a second incompatible state machine.
